subject: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@limo-express.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows

Hi Samir —

We have an executive offsite for our customer Acme Financial on Friday, May 29 at the Saddlebrook Conference Center. Headcount is 18 attendees (3 VIPs). Can you send an initial proposal for ground coverage that includes:
- Vehicle mix (sedan/SUV/van) to cover 18 pax + luggage, with 2 VIP sedans reserved
- One wheelchair-accessible vehicle on standby
- Staging lane recommendation for arrival windows between 08:00–10:30 (staggered arrivals)
- Onsite POC and driver contact numbers
- High-level estimate (flat + per-mile) and any deposit/payment terms

Attached is the attendee_manifest_v1.csv (names, arrival flights, luggage notes). We need a draft SOW by EOD Wednesday so we can include it in the onsite runbook.

Marissa/Neha — flag anything I missed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
P: 415-555-0132

Attachment: attendee_manifest_v1.csv (CSV stub, 1 page)
From: Samir Patel <samir@limo-express.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Limo Express Ops <ops@limo-express.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows

Jonas —

Thanks for the details and the manifest. Quick read-through and a proposed plan below:

Proposed fleet (pickup at SFO, drop at Saddlebrook):
- 2x Luxury sedans (VIPs) — dedicated drivers, meet-and-greet
- 3x Standard sedans — 6 pax
- 2x 8-passenger vans — bulk luggage/teams
- 1x wheelchair-accessible van on standby
- 3x Backup sedans (on-call, for last-minute changes)

Staging & timing:
- We'll hold one staging lane at the Hotel Loading Dock A from 07:30–11:00.
- Drivers will be on-site 45 min prior to the first pickup window.
- For arrivals between 08:00–10:30 we recommend 30-minute pickup windows per flight to avoid overlap; we can push earlier arrivals to a holding lot if necessary.

Cost (ballpark): $1,850 flat + $2.25/mi (estimate; final depends on total miles). Deposit: 30% to secure VIP sedans.

Deliverables by Wed EOD: draft SOW and driver manifest. See attached draft SOW (LimoExpress_SOW_v1.pdf).

Samir
Samir Patel | Limo Express
ops@limo-express.com | 650-555-2210

Attachment: LimoExpress_SOW_v1.pdf (1-page SOW stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@limo-express.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows

Quick notes from the onsite logistics perspective:
- Please confirm the wheelchair-accessible vehicle is ADA-compliant and driver trained for securement.
- We need explicit VIP parking passes for the two VIP sedans at the front porte-cochere between 07:30–12:00. Can you include those in the SOW?
- Add a 30-minute buffer between arrival windows for tight turnaround; we've had taxi lanes back up in the past.
- Can Samir include a line-item for driver cell numbers and onsite radios (if available)? That helps our security team.

If pricing looks good we'll route the deposit through procurement once we have the finalized SOW.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@limo-express.com>, Limo Express Ops <ops@limo-express.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Emily Ross <emily.ross@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows

Samir —

Thanks for the draft. Per Marissa, please:
- Confirm ADA compliance and include driver training note in SOW.
- Add VIP parking pass line in SOW for two sedans (07:30–12:00).
- Add drivers' cell numbers and onsite radio availability.
- Add a 30-minute buffer between pickup windows; we've adjusted the final windows accordingly — final_pickup_windows.csv attached (includes exact flight times and assigned window).

Emily (Acme) — looping you in so you have visibility; reach out if you want different staging.

Please send final SOW + driver manifest by EOD so procurement can issue the deposit request tomorrow morning.

Appreciate it,
Jonas

Attachment: final_pickup_windows.csv (CSV stub)

Subject: Re: Exec offsite — fleet allocation and staging windows

Jonas/Marissa —

Confirmed. Updated deliverables attached: driver_manifest-LE-20260512.csv and invoice-stub.pdf. Highlights:
- ADA-compliant wheelchair van confirmed (VIN masked for privacy); driver has securement certification.
- VIP passes: 2 x porte-cochere pass (07:30–12:00) — hotel contact: Laura Bennett, Events (laura.bennett@saddlebrook.com).
- Drivers and cell numbers included in driver manifest; we will distribute on-site radios if cell coverage is poor.
- SOW updated to include 30% deposit terms and cancellation windows.

Please confirm the invoice, and we will issue the deposit link (Stripe/ACH options). Looking forward to supporting the event.

Best,
Ops Team
Limo Express
